author: Codex
scope: Exact saved exclusion of one outer fold or two distinct outer/inner folds
producer_reads: Global membership metadata plus permitted capital files projected to metadata,original capital and written premium; no targets,claims,exposure or model predictors
normal_population: Finite capital in (0,1e7],nonempty; ppm=1000*premium/capital must be positive and finite for every normal row; no fallback,imputation,quantile or relaxed band
output_evidence: Normal population records and keys/content SHA,scope bindings,source files,producer code SHA,author,zoned UTC,receipt pinned by path/SHA and artifact payload SHA
connector_verification: Check artifact/receipt/population bindings before value reading; replay exact normal population and arithmetic against permitted capital after scoped loading; reject differences,never update parameters silently
population_selection_limit: Reference population selection does not delete periods or claims from learning inputs
premium_role: Audit-only quality dependency; excluded from model features
origins: Computed synthetic parameters have synthetic_scope_estimation_receipt; contest parameters require exact_scope_estimation_receipt and matching real input provenance. No transfer between origins.
learning_signature: Parameter payload and normal population content plus permitted inputs; excludes receipt path,author,UTC and archival global request hash. Archival seals may differ under protected changes.
validation_scope_this_cycle: Generated Parquet only; real manifest metadata requests may be prepared but no real parameter production,capital application or value decoding
